---
title: "Sensitivity models"
description: "Environmental sensitivity models fitted with and without a scale component."
---

## Overview

This chapter defines the sensitivity analysis for the direct environmental predictor set. The same fixed effects are fitted in two versions: a mean-only model with a single global precision parameter (`phi ~ 1`) and a location- scale model where the environmental-geographic predictors and methodological controls are also included in the scale component.

Both models include methodological controls (`nest_box`, `marker_type`) and the same population, species, and phylogenetic random-effect structure as the main models.

```{r}
#| label: sensitivity-setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(knitr)

model_dir <- "models/sensitivity_models"

first_existing <- function(paths) {
  existing <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(existing) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  existing[1]
}



summary_files <- list(
  first_month_mu = first_existing(c(file.path(model_dir, "summary_m_sensitivity_first_month_mu.txt"))),
  first_month_mu_phi = first_existing(c(file.path(model_dir, "summary_m_sensitivity_first_month_mu_phi.txt")))
)
show_saved_summary <- function(summary_file, label) {
  if (!is.na(summary_file) && file.exists(summary_file)) {
    cat("<details><summary>", label, "</summary>\n\n```\n", sep = "")
    cat(readLines(summary_file), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n```\n</details>\n")
  }
}
```

## Predictors

| Model | Mean component predictors | Scale component |
|----|----|----|
| Mean-only | `tmp_cru_C_first_month_z`, `pre_cru_mm_first_month_log_z`, `dtr_cru_C_first_month_z`, `ndvi_first_month_median_30km_z`, `abs_latitude_z`, `distance_to_coast_z`, `nest_box`, `marker_type` | `phi ~ 1` |
| location-scale | Same mean model | `phi ~ tmp_cru_C_first_month_z + pre_cru_mm_first_month_log_z + dtr_cru_C_first_month_z + ndvi_first_month_median_30km_z + abs_latitude_z + distance_to_coast_z + nest_box + marker_type` |

## Mean-only sensitivity model

```{r}
#| label: sensitivity-first-month-mu-code
#| eval: false

m_sensitivity_first_month_mu <- brms::brm(
  n_epp_broods | trials(n_broods_sampled) ~
    tmp_cru_C_first_month_z +
    pre_cru_mm_first_month_log_z +
    dtr_cru_C_first_month_z +
    ndvi_first_month_median_30km_z +
    abs_latitude_z +
    distance_to_coast_z +
    nest_box +
    marker_type +
    (1 | population_id) +
    (1 | species_nonphylo) +
    (1 | gr(species_phylo, cov = phylo_mat_fit)),
  data = dat_fit,
  data2 = list(phylo_mat_fit = phylo_mat_fit),
  family = brms::beta_binomial(link = "logit", link_phi = "log"),
  prior = priors_mu,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 10000,
  warmup = 5000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 1501,
  save_pars = brms::save_pars(all = TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: sensitivity-first-month-mu-summary
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

show_saved_summary(summary_files$first_month_mu, "Show summary for the mean-only sensitivity model")
```

## Environmental effect plots

The panel below shows model-predicted EPP along the four direct environmental predictors from the mean-only sensitivity model. Lines show posterior mean predictions, ribbons show 95% credible intervals, and raw observations are shown only as a light background layer.

```{r}
#| label: sensitivity-environmental-effects-panel

## Mean-scale sensitivity model

```{r}
#| label: sensitivity-first-month-mu-phi-code
#| eval: false

m_sensitivity_first_month_mu_phi <- brms::brm(
  brms::bf(
    n_epp_broods | trials(n_broods_sampled) ~
      tmp_cru_C_first_month_z +
      pre_cru_mm_first_month_log_z +
      dtr_cru_C_first_month_z +
      ndvi_first_month_median_30km_z +
      abs_latitude_z +
      distance_to_coast_z +
      nest_box +
      marker_type +
      (1 | population_id) +
      (1 | species_nonphylo) +
      (1 | gr(species_phylo, cov = phylo_mat_fit)),

    phi ~
      tmp_cru_C_first_month_z +
      pre_cru_mm_first_month_log_z +
      dtr_cru_C_first_month_z +
      ndvi_first_month_median_30km_z +
      abs_latitude_z +
      distance_to_coast_z +
      nest_box +
      marker_type
  ),
  data = dat_fit,
  data2 = list(phylo_mat_fit = phylo_mat_fit),
  family = brms::beta_binomial(link = "logit", link_phi = "log"),
  prior = priors_mu_phi,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 10000,
  warmup = 5000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 1502,
  save_pars = brms::save_pars(all = TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: sensitivity-first-month-mu-phi-summary
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

show_saved_summary(summary_files$first_month_mu_phi, "Show summary for the location-scale sensitivity model")
```

## Predictive support and LOO diagnostics

LOO comparisons are used here to summarise support for the location-scale sensitivity model relative to the mean-only sensitivity model, and to compare the PCA sensitivity model with PC1 and PC2 against the version that also includes PC3. Higher expected log predictive density indicates better expected out-of-sample prediction. Pareto-k diagnostics are reported because high values indicate that LOO estimates should be interpreted cautiously.

```{r}
#| label: sensitivity-loo-support
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

loo_compare_file <- file.path(model_dir, "loo_compare_sensitivity_models.csv")
loo_compare_text_file <- file.path(model_dir, "loo_compare_sensitivity_models.txt")
loo_diagnostics_file <- file.path(model_dir, "loo_diagnostics_sensitivity_models.csv")

if (file.exists(loo_compare_text_file)) {
  cat("<details open><summary>Show saved LOO comparison output</summary>\n\n```\n")
  cat(readLines(loo_compare_text_file), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n```\n</details>\n")
} else if (file.exists(loo_compare_file)) {
  read_csv(loo_compare_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
    kable()
} else {
  cat("Sensitivity LOO comparison file is not available yet.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: sensitivity-loo-diagnostics
#| echo: false

if (file.exists(loo_diagnostics_file)) {
  read_csv(loo_diagnostics_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
    kable()
} else {
  cat("Sensitivity LOO diagnostics file is not available yet.")
}
```

For the direct first-month predictor set, the location-scale model has higher expected predictive performance than the mean-only model in the available LOO comparison. However, Pareto-k diagnostics include high values, so this comparison should be treated as supportive but not definitive. For the PCA dimensionality check, adding PC3 provides little additional predictive support relative to the PC1+PC2 model.
